name: Compile Time Tracker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform: [single-card, t3k, galaxy]
    env:
      TT_METAL_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Cache pip packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake ninja-build

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DTT_METAL_PLATFORM=${{ env.TT_METAL_PLATFORM }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build -- -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run C++ tests
        run: |
          ctest --test-dir build -V

      - name: Run Python tests (excluding extended models)
        run: |
          pytest -m "not models-extended" -vv

      - name: Run mandatory model tests
        run: |
          pytest -m "models-mandatory" -vv

yaml:
name: Compile Time Tracker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform: [single-card, t3k, galaxy]
    env:
      TT_METAL_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Cache pip packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake ninja-build

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DTT_METAL_PLATFORM=${{ env.TT_METAL_PLATFORM }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build -- -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run C++ tests
        run: |
          ctest --test-dir build -V

      - name: Run Python tests (excluding extended models)
        run: |
          pytest -m "not models-extended" -vv

      - name: Run mandatory model tests
        run: |
          pytest -m "models-mandatory" -vv
